newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Continente Q1 net at 1.84 bln pta.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Continente Q1 net at 1.84 bln pta.

text.p: Spanish hypermarket chain Continente said on Friday its first-quarter net profit narrowed to 1.84 billion pesetas versus 2.12 billion pesetas in the year-ago first quarter.

But the company added in a statement that a fair comparison would be to consider net profit at 2.07 billion pesetas this year, adding that such a value would result without taking into account its balance sheet revaluation.
Turnover was eight percent higher at 102.99 billion pesetas versus 95.30 billion pesetas.
Continente's pretax profit was at 2.74 billion pesetas, with the revaluation, and at 3.09 billion pesetas without it.
In 1996, the group's first-quarter pretax profit was 2.9 billion pesetas.
The company's cash flow rose three percent to 4.7 billion pesetas versus 4.6 billion.
